hero.title: Take Control of Your Financial Journey
hero.subtitle: Track expenses, manage investments, and build wealth with powerful analytics - all in one beautiful app.

features.sectionSubtitle: Powerful features to help you manage your complete financial life
features.multiWalletDesc: Manage multiple wallets for different purposes - cash, savings, investments, and more.
features.portfolioTrackingDesc: Track stocks, crypto, gold, silver, ETFs and more with real-time market data.
features.mobileFirstDesc: Beautiful, touch-friendly interface that works perfectly on any device.
features.goldSilverDesc: Track Vietnamese and world gold/silver with automatic unit conversions.
features.smartTransactionsDesc: Categorize, search, and analyze all your income and expenses.
features.bankImportDesc: Import transactions from your bank CSV statements with smart duplicate detection.
features.analyticsDesc: Visualize your financial health with interactive charts and detailed reports.
features.reportsDesc: Generate comprehensive reports and export to CSV, PDF, or Excel.
features.budgetPlanningDesc: Set budgets, track spending, and stay on top of your financial goals.
features.multiCurrencyDesc: Seamlessly manage finances across different currencies with real-time conversion.
features.marketDataDesc: Get up-to-date prices for stocks, crypto, gold, and more from Yahoo Finance.
features.secureAuthDesc: Sign in securely with your Google account. No passwords to remember.
features.allInOnePlatformDesc: From expense tracking to multi-asset portfolio management. Track stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, crypto, gold, and silver with FIFO accounting, real-time market data, and powerful analytics - all in one unified platform.
features.multiWalletDescLong: Create unlimited BASIC and INVESTMENT wallets. Transfer funds seamlessly between accounts with real-time balance updates.
features.portfolioTrackingDescLong: Track stocks, crypto, ETFs, bonds, mutual funds, and commodities with real-time Yahoo Finance market data integration.
features.mobileFirstDescLong: Fully responsive layout optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop. Touch-friendly interactions with pull-to-refresh and smooth animations.
features.goldSilverDescLong: Specialized support for Vietnamese SJC gold (10 varieties), world gold (XAU), and silver with automatic tael/gram/ounce conversions.
features.smartTransactionsDescLong: Categorize income and expenses with custom categories. Advanced filtering by wallet, date range, amount, and text search.
features.bankImportDescLong: Bulk import transactions from CSV, Excel, or PDF statements. Smart duplicate detection, auto-categorization, and 24-hour undo.
features.analyticsDescLong: Beautiful charts showing balance history, income vs expenses, wallet distribution, and portfolio performance with interactive tooltips.
features.reportsDescLong: Generate period-based reports with comparison analysis. Export to CSV, PDF, or Excel with category-specific filtering.
features.budgetPlanningDescLong: Create custom budgets with multiple items. Visual progress indicators and completion tracking to stay on target.
features.multiCurrencyDescLong: Support for 12+ global currencies (USD, VND, EUR, GBP, JPY, HKD, AUD, CAD, SGD) with automatic FX conversion.
features.marketDataDescLong: Live price updates from Yahoo Finance API with 15-minute caching. Symbol search autocomplete for stocks, crypto, and ETFs.
features.secureAuthDescLong: One-click sign-up with Google OAuth. JWT tokens with Redis whitelist for maximum security. No passwords to remember.

investmentFeatures.sectionSubtitle: Track ALL your investments in one unified portfolio
investmentFeatures.allAssetsDesc: Track ALL your investments in one unified portfolio
investmentFeatures.powerfulAnalyticsDesc: FIFO accounting and smart metrics across ALL your assets
investmentFeatures.goldSilverSupportDesc: Vietnam gold market + world gold prices with automatic unit conversions
investmentFeatures.whyJuggle: Why juggle Coinbase, Robinhood, spreadsheets, and gold dealers? Track stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, crypto, gold, and silver in one unified platform with FIFO accounting, real-time market data, and powerful analytics.
investmentFeatures.onePortfolio: One Portfolio. All Assets. Complete Picture.
investmentFeatures.fifoAccounting: FIFO accounting across ALL asset types - stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, crypto, gold, and silver. Track realized/unrealized PNL, cost basis, and your complete net worth in one unified dashboard with automatic lot tracking.
investmentFeatures.goldSilverSupportDescLong: Unique support for precious metals with flexible unit conversions

bankImport.sectionSubtitle: Import your bank statements in seconds
bankImport.stopTypingDesc: Import hundreds of transactions in minutes. Upload your bank statement in CSV, Excel, or PDF format and let our smart system handle the rest. No more manual entry tedium.
bankImport.smartDuplicateDesc: 99% accuracy prevents duplicate entries with multi-level matching (exact, strong, likely, possible).
bankImport.autoCategorisationDesc: Intelligent merchant database and keyword matching auto-suggests categories with confidence scores.
bankImport.multiCurrencyDesc: Automatic FX conversion for 12+ currencies with historical exchange rates from trusted APIs.
bankImport.reviewEditDesc: Inline editing with real-time validation. Fix errors, adjust categories, and handle duplicates before import.
bankImport.twentyFourHourUndoDesc: Made a mistake? Undo any import within 24 hours to restore the pre-import state completely.
bankImport.lightningFastDesc: Import 500+ transactions in under 10 minutes with optimized parsing and bulk insert operations.
bankImport.uploadStatementDesc: Drag & drop your CSV, Excel, or PDF bank statement. Supports up to 10,000 transactions per file.
bankImport.reviewConfirmDesc: Smart system auto-categorizes transactions, detects duplicates, and flags errors for your review.
bankImport.importCompleteDesc: Transactions imported instantly. View summary, edit categories, or undo within 24 hours if needed.
bankImport.ctaText: Stop forgetting to track expenses. Import your statement once a month and stay on top of your finances.

howItWorks.step1Desc: Create your account securely using Google OAuth. No passwords to remember.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Set up BASIC or INVESTMENT wallets. Add your initial balance to get started.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Track stocks, crypto, gold, and more. Record buys, sells, and dividends automatically.
howItWorks.step4Desc: View real-time PNL, portfolio allocation, and detailed analytics for informed decisions.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Export your data to CSV for deeper analysis. Keep your financial data portable.
howItWorks.getStartedDesc: From sign-up to tracking your investments in just 5 simple steps.
